commit d28d038de0331056e38fc2bb46474aaaf086e340
Author:     Welpy-cw <58345540+Welpy-cw@users.noreply.github.com>
AuthorDate: Tue Aug 18 13:19:29 2026 +0100
Commit:     brendan@thunderbird.net <brendan@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Wed Aug 19 10:26:18 2026 +0000

    Bug 2061484 - Remove explicit accesskeys in 'Move To' and 'Copy To' menus. r=mkmelin,tobyp,coreycb
    
    Remove the explicit .accesskey attributes from the 'Favorites' and
    'Recent Destinations' menu items in the 'Move To'/'Copy To' submenu.
    
    While these accesskeys were originally present as well, Bug 1558565,
    landing in Thunderbird 68, inadvertently removed them due to a typo
    (`accessKey` instead of `accesskey`)
    
    This accidental removal led to the preferred behavior: pressing a letter
    cycled through all menu items beginning with that letter, including user
    account names and folders.
    
    When Bug 2012355 re-introduced those accesskeys along with the fluent
    migration, it actually created a usability regression, which is fixed by
    this patch.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D319419

diff --git a/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/messenger.ftl b/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/messenger.ftl
index 63bb7c7b666..8db48eadd95 100644
--- a/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/messenger.ftl
+++ b/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/messenger.ftl
@@ -280,13 +280,11 @@ menu-copy-to =
     .label = Copy To
     .accesskey = C
 
-menu-move-copy-recent-destinations =
+menu-move-copy-recent-destinations-no-accesskey =
     .label = Recent Destinations
-    .accesskey = R
 
-menu-move-copy-favorites =
+menu-move-copy-favorites-no-accesskey =
     .label = Favorites
-    .accesskey = F
 
 menu-move-copy-no-recent =
     .label = (No recent destinations)
diff --git a/mailnews/base/content/folder-menupopup.js b/mailnews/base/content/folder-menupopup.js
index 3454096d802..eb91739eeca 100644
--- a/mailnews/base/content/folder-menupopup.js
+++ b/mailnews/base/content/folder-menupopup.js
@@ -502,7 +502,7 @@
           this.childWrapper.appendChild(
             this._buildSpecialMenu({
               special: "recent",
-              "data-l10n-id": "menu-move-copy-recent-destinations",
+              "data-l10n-id": "menu-move-copy-recent-destinations-no-accesskey",
             })
           );
         }
@@ -510,7 +510,7 @@
           this.childWrapper.appendChild(
             this._buildSpecialMenu({
               special: "favorites",
-              "data-l10n-id": "menu-move-copy-favorites",
+              "data-l10n-id": "menu-move-copy-favorites-no-accesskey",
             })
           );
         }
diff --git a/python/l10n/tb_fluent_migrations/bug_2061484_remove_move_copy_accesskeys.py b/python/l10n/tb_fluent_migrations/bug_2061484_remove_move_copy_accesskeys.py
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..931236a135a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/python/l10n/tb_fluent_migrations/bug_2061484_remove_move_copy_accesskeys.py
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+# Any copyright is dedicated to the Public Domain.
+# http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
+
+from fluent.migratetb import COPY_PATTERN
+from fluent.migratetb.helpers import transforms_from
+
+
+def migrate(ctx):
+    """Bug 2061484 - Remove explicit accesskeys in Move To and Copy To menus, part {index}."""
+
+    target = reference = "mail/messenger/messenger.ftl"
+
+    ctx.add_transforms(
+        target,
+        reference,
+        transforms_from(
+            """
+menu-move-copy-recent-destinations-no-accesskey =
+    .label = { COPY_PATTERN(from_path, "menu-move-copy-recent-destinations.label") }
+
+menu-move-copy-favorites-no-accesskey =
+    .label = { COPY_PATTERN(from_path, "menu-move-copy-favorites.label") }
+            """,
+            from_path=target,
+        ),
+    )
title: Bug 2061484 - Remove explicit accesskeys in 'Move To' and 'Copy To' menus. r=mkmelin,tobyp,coreycb
